recipe.visualDefinition: A complex black-and-white line drawing featuring surrealist portraits of four men integrated into a landscape of rocks and water, framed by an intricate, dense border of floral and abstract patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: Central surrealist figures anchored within a landscape
Dense, busy border framing a more open central composition
Consistent fine-line weight across both figures and environment
High-contrast relationship between dark ink and cream-toned paper
coreInvariants: Monochrome black ink on off-white/cream background
Surrealist facial features with heavy contouring
Intricate, repetitive line patterns for hair and textures
Double-line rectangular frame separating the border from the main scene

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four large-scale heads arranged horizontally across the center-midground, emerging from rocky terrain.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The four central faces, particularly the two upright figures in the middle-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the left-most reclining figure across the row of faces to the right, then outward to the detailed border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The sky area above the figures provides the only significant visual relief from the dense line work.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with zero saturation in the illustration; low-saturation dark accent in the text.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected cursive with a consistent slant
Thick-to-thin stroke modulation reminiscent of a brush or broad-nib pen
Letters are outlined with a thin black stroke and filled with solid color
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'P' and 'L' feature exaggerated, elegant loops
Lowercase 'v' and 'e' have tight, rhythmic connections

composition.position: Top and bottom center, outside the inner frame
composition.overlap: Slightly overlaps the inner border frame
composition.relationshipToImage: Floating above and below the central scene

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A single expressive script used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fluid, hand-drawn feel of the original lettering.
Best for replicating the specific stroke modulation and outlines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a black and white pen-and-ink illustration on cream paper. The center features four surrealist male portraits emerging from a rocky landscape with water in the foreground and stylized clouds in the sky. Surround the scene with a dense, intricate border of hand-drawn floral and abstract patterns, separated from the center by a double-line rectangular frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add title text in the top and bottom center margins using a bold, calligraphic script in dark maroon with a thin black outline. The text should slightly overlap the inner border lines.

verificationChecks: Is the line work consistently fine and detailed?
Do the faces have a surreal, 1970s folk-art quality?
Is the border sufficiently dense and complex?
Is the typography a dark maroon script with a black outline?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the cream background
Scale of the central figures relative to the frame
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent line weight across the entire image.
Ensure the script text is legible despite the busy background.
Verify the cream/off-white tone is warm and aged-looking.
Confirm the surrealist elements (heads in rocks) are clearly defined.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surrealist Portraiture] + [Intricate Pen-and-Ink Border] + [Cream Paper Texture] + [Bold Calligraphic Script Overlay] to achieve a 1970s folk-psychedelic aesthetic.
